site.name: the old Rawalpindi-area site
site.signature_geometry: previously noted perimeter berm and access road configuration largely unchanged from the 2024-11 baseline; two of the hardstand pads; the northern or southern pad clusters; cleared laydown area; fenced compound
site.source_quote: The site in question — referred to in prior open reporting simply as "the old Rawalpindi-area site" near the port road turnoff, not the garrison itself — was tasked for revisit collection this cycle following unconfirmed claims circulating on regional defense forums of a battery relocation. The area consistent with the suspected forward site shows the previously noted perimeter berm and access road configuration largely unchanged from the 2024-11 baseline. Vegetation growth along the eastern edge has advanced somewhat and now partially shadows two of the hardstand pads noted in earlier passes. Current imagery is assessed as a negative TEL presence observation for the pass window noted.

payload.count_object: small vehicles, structures, and construction objects
payload.description: A nadir overhead frame shows a dense urban district surrounding a large irregular bare-earth parcel. The parcel contains a prominent circular looped paved or graded feature divided by a narrow north-south linear strip, with curved side segments and several rectangular pads or spurs. Multiple parallel diagonal linear features cross the parcel's northern section. Scattered small buildings, foundations, temporary-looking structures, and construction materials occupy the rest of the site. Broad paved roads and intersections border the area, while dense rows of rectangular buildings, additional construction lots, a small athletic court, and a landscaped institutional-looking compound fill the surroundings.
